subject: SIG: scoped identity & provisioning evidence request
messages:
From: Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@medlytics.com>

Cc: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@medlytics.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Jul 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: initial access control evidence request

Hi Rishi,

We're working through the SIG for our vendor review and have a few items outstanding around identity and access controls. Could you confirm the following and provide any artifacts/evidence you can share?

- SSO/SAML: IdP metadata, cert rotation policy, assertion lifetime, and whether you support SP-initiated flow.
- SCIM: provisioning API/version, user lifecycle events (provision/deprovision/suspend), typical deprovisioning latency, and an example event payload.
- RBAC & least privilege: list of built-in roles, whether custom roles are supported, and an export of role->permission mappings.
- MFA: do you enforce at the platform level or rely on IdP? Any support for step-up authentication for sensitive ops?

Procurement also asked if you can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report — happy to sign an NDA if needed. We're on a tight timeline (security board next Wednesday).

Thanks — Michelle
Michelle Tan
Information Security
MedLytics

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Michelle Tan <michelle.tan@medlytics.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG: initial access control evidence request — technical details

Hi Michelle / Rishi — taking the tech questions in order below. I've included examples and notes inline; I've attached a SCIM flow diagram and RBAC matrix for quick reference. If you want raw export formats we can provide JSON/CSV extracts.

- SSO / SAML
  - We support SAML 2.0 and both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
  - Typical assertion lifetime: 5 minutes (configurable by customer through IdP settings).
  - Certificate rotation: we support rotating SP certs with a 30-day overlap window to avoid outages; IdP cert rotation is customer-managed.
  - SAML metadata: attached (SAML-metadata.xml) — includes ACS/endpoints and entityID.

- SCIM
  - We implement SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning/deprovisioning (PATCH/POST/DELETE).
  - Events supported: create user, update attributes (email, title, manager), deactivate (user.active=false), delete.
  - Typical deprovision latency: near-real-time for most IdPs; for delta-based syncs we recommend provisioning on change with periodic full syncs nightly.
  - Example payloads and rate limits: included in the attachment. See SCIM-flow.png for lifecycle.

- RBAC & least privilege
  - Built-in roles: account_admin, team_admin, app_user, read_only.
  - Custom roles: yes, customers can create custom roles scoped to teams with granular permissions.
  - Permission model: resource-scoped (model endpoint, dataset, project) + action (read, write, deploy, admin).
  - Default least-privilege guidance: new users default to app_user (no admin rights). Admin role required to create API keys or change billing.
  - We can export role->permission mapping; attached is an example CSV (RBAC-matrix.csv). If you need a full export for your audit, tell us the desired format (CSV/JSON).

- MFA and session controls
  - MFA is enforced at IdP for SSO customers (Redwood does not require an additional platform MFA by default).
  - For customers who use native accounts (rare), we support TOTP-based MFA.
  - Step-up: we support step-up for sensitive ops (e.g., key creation, removal of admin) via a confirmation flow and can require re-authentication for those operations.
  - Session length: default 8 hours for SSO sessions; can be shortened via session controls and token TTL.

- Evidence and artifacts
  - Attached: SCIM-flow.png, RBAC-matrix.csv, SAML-metadata.xml.
  - We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II after NDA.
  - Also attaching a short FAQ we send to customers when onboarding SSO/SCIM.

If you want a live demo of SCIM provisioning or an RBAC export of your trial account, we can schedule that — Rishi, what times look good next week?

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SCIM-flow.png (diagram), RBAC-matrix.csv (example export), SAML-metadata.xml (SP metadata)

- Once the addendum is executed we provide a redacted copy of SOC 2 Type II limited to controls and testing results; customer-identifying data is removed.
- For technical artifacts (SCIM payloads, RBAC exports) we can provide those directly without an NDA.

I've prepared the DocuSign envelope — link below. Please sign and we'll send the redacted SOC 2 within 24 business hours.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef-nda-placeholder (DocuSign-NDA-link.txt attached)
